statement: Every lot of an order is either filled (and leaves its maker's offer by the same lots), rests, or is dropped with a reason; no lot is created or lost.
source: Hub matching engine thread, coordinator brief 10-01 02:56 (Arthur: the matching engine is a parallel job; the swap clause stays the Account's)

layers.arrival: n/a: a hub-local matching engine: no peer sees the book, only the swap clauses it produces (R-SWAP-ONCHAIN)
layers.quint: n/a: a hub-local matching engine: no peer sees the book, only the swap clauses it produces (R-SWAP-ONCHAIN)
layers.contract: n/a: an off-chain hub engine; the chain sees only the signed swap clause (R-SWAP-ONCHAIN)

killers.name: R-BOOK-LOTS-CONSERVED a partial fill leaves the maker's rest in place, at the front of its price
R-BOOK-LOTS-CONSERVED a taker's unfilled lots rest, and the fills plus the rest are the order
R-BOOK-LOTS-CONSERVED an offer that fills exactly leaves the book
